authority: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom

steps.title: Raising Consumer Complaint or Commercial Claim
steps.description: Consumer raises complaint with the trader or relevant authority, or a commercial claimant prepares a claim for court proceedings.

steps.title: Alternative Dispute Resolution
steps.description: Parties may attempt alternative dispute resolution, including negotiation or mediation, where applicable.

steps.title: Filing of Claim
steps.description: Claim is filed before the appropriate civil court in accordance with the Civil Procedure Rules.

steps.title: Service of Claim and Defence
steps.description: Claim is served on the defendant, who files a defence within the prescribed timeframe.

steps.title: Case Management and Evidence
steps.description: Court manages the case, issues directions, and oversees disclosure of documents and evidence.

steps.title: Hearing or Trial
steps.description: Court hears the dispute and considers evidence and submissions.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment resolving the consumer or commercial dispute.

steps.title: Enforcement
steps.description: Judgment may be enforced if not complied with voluntarily.

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal on a point of law or procedure as permitted under Civil Procedure Rules

escalation_paths.to: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom
escalation_paths.condition: Appeal on a point of law of general public importance
